newsitem.title: JAPAN: Asahi Breweries' shares rise in Tokyo, Kirin falls.
newsitem.headline: Asahi Breweries' shares rise in Tokyo, Kirin falls.

text.p: Shares of leading Japanese beer maker Asahi Breweries Ltd rose in Tokyo on Thursday, spurred by news of robust beer sales at home as well as a possible upgrade of its long-term debt rating, brokers said.
By 0342 GMT, Asahi's shares had gained 40 yen to stand at 1,670 yen, in a turnover of 1.17 million.
In contrast, shares of Kirin Brewery Co Ltd, Asahi's biggest domestic rival, fell by 10 yen to stand at 1,150 yen, in a turnover of 304,000.
